description: Validates and prices a formation order and returns the exact summary that would be submitted, WITHOUT submitting anything (no side effects). Use when the user wants FilingDesk to form their LLC or corporation and has provided the business name, state, entity type, and their name, email, and phone. The returned summary is meant to be shown to the user verbatim, and this step is required before submit_order.

businessName.description: Proposed company name. Does not need to be final — a specialist verifies availability.

description.description: One or two sentences on what the business does. Optional — the user may skip it.

email.description: The customer's email. Required — this is where documents go. Temporary/disposable inboxes are rejected.

entityType.description: Entity type, e.g. "LLC", "S-Corp", "C-Corp", or "Not sure" if the user hasn't decided.

phone.description: The customer's phone number with area code. Required — used only if the state or the specialist has a question about the filing.

state.description: Two-letter state code or full state name, e.g. "WY" or "Wyoming". All 50 states + DC.

name: preview_order
title: Preview a formation order
